references.type: Released Downpour creature gallery, 300×300 close view
references.observation: Seven stretched tapered sectors and material-to-band seams; the exposed central face has a ring on viewer right. Follow the visible tissue up to each seam.
Luminous ocular lens and face integrated into the wall. The remote brackets and mine train are scenery.
Scene placement and pale illuminated lens; silhouette of the attachment machinery is outside the selection subject.

attempts.prompt: One transparent raster sprite, front-facing selection portrait of the entire visible facial membrane of the Monocle Man from the 2012 retail Silent Hill: Downpour Devil’s Pit train scene. The first reference establishes the exact face, outline and materials. Show the recognizable physical face with its heavy frowning mouth, flattened broad nose, shadowed eye on the viewer's left and the small circular metal monocle lit ivory on the viewer's right. The pale weathered ochre-gray membrane around this face stretches outward into seven irregular tapered anchoring sectors like the source. Follow the angular outer silhouette of the biological membrane closely. End each sector where pale stretched tissue naturally enters the short dark metal band visible on the reference. Include the short bands at the cutoffs and tiny embedded fasteners. The facial object ends there; external rails, hanging chains, mine wall and train are scene elements. Keep the thin diagonal chain on the face where it directly joins the monocle. Only the head is visible in the shipping game, so give a single complete view of this particular membrane, not a detached round skull, humanoid body, fleshy tentacles or tongue. Preserve the source's facial asymmetry and subtle strained folds. All attachment tips must be within the canvas with transparent breathing room on every side. Use restrained original-game lighting, high-resolution naturalistic material, modest glint from the lens. True alpha, no backdrop, halo, floor, UI, text or scenery. Single subject at highest native resolution.

Create one high-resolution true transparent raster sprite for a 2D lateral fighting game, Silent Hill: Halo of Flesh. Female Sniffer Dog from Silent Hill 4 (2004), lean mottled brown canine body, irregular reddish ochre surface and the prominent long tongue visible in the original game render. STRICT RIGHT-facing profile at ground level. Plant its hind feet, lower the front of the chest in a coiled asymmetric crouch, extend the nose toward the opponent, tongue curling downward and slightly forward; both long front legs angled separately. No rider, collar or chains. All paws and tongue visible. The initial references show the original edition, the last is the existing selection image for visual continuity. Repose the subject so the side contour, facing and weight distribution are unmistakably different from the selection. Neutral readable game lighting, full subject within generous alpha padding on all four sides, no floor, no contact shadow, scenery, text, decals, border or second figure. Highest available native resolution.
